Definition: the paunch or belly (as swelling out)
BiblicalUsage: Keres means the belly, the paunch. Jeremiah 51:34 says Nebuchadrezzar hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Babylon's belly is never full, and God will make her give back what she swallowed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
